etf_flow_correction.source_independence: These aggregators use overlapping issuer holdings files but different fund universes, settlement dates and missing-file rules. Holdings changes are not independently verified cash subscriptions. Do not average or label the cohorts independent.

sbi_ripple_asia.source_note: SBI Group's 60% is a consolidated group voting-rights aggregate.

xrp_activity_distinction.source: Ripple official SBI Ripple Asia profile
xrp_activity_distinction.finding: SBI Ripple Asia says it does not handle XRP directly; its business is RippleNet software services to financial institutions and remittance businesses. Do not equate RippleNet adoption with native XRP settlement.

actual_xrp_remittance.finding: SBI Remit sends customer payment requests; SBI VC Trade sends XRP in real time; Tranglo processes local-currency payouts. The corridor expansion covered bank-account remittances to the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia. XRP is explicitly used as a bridge between fiat currencies.

xrpl_research_not_live.finding: SBI Ripple Asia and DSRV began research on Japan-Korea blockchain remittance/payment use cases, considering XRPL. This is research, not verified production XRP volume.

tokenized_deposits_poc.finding: Conceptual proof of concept for tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money using MoneyTap and a token issuance platform, with XRPL considered. Not evidence of a live XRP liquidity requirement.

sbi_circle.finding: SBI Circle Holdings / Circle SBI Japan KK is a 50/50 JV; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank invested $25M each in Circle's IPO, total $50M. Arc is a separate L1, not XRPL.

sbi_evernorth_coinbase.finding: Four SBI-controlled entities and 39.9% SBI-group voting power after closing; exact SBI cash/XRP contribution allocation is undisclosed. Coinbase is Evernorth's principal XRP market for financial reporting, not an exclusive venue/custodian or direct SBI-Coinbase partnership.

identity.sbic: SBIC East/Tokyo, Central/Nagoya and West/Osaka are separate regional SME investment companies, not SBI Holdings. SBIC East's official 2025 ChatGPT/Copilot course was restricted to investee companies; its separate ChatGPT seminar was co-hosted with the Tokyo Chamber of Commerce Taito branch and featured a Microsoft speaker. Educational, not an OpenAI partnership.
identity.actual_capital: Evernorth gross cash, in-kind XRP, cash-funded XRP purchases, PIK debt, related-party facility, ELOC capacity, warrants and secondary resales remain separate. The ELOC had zero proceeds as of Nov9.
identity.kamilah_youtube: Third-party IDCrawl lists 20 similarly named YouTube profiles, including a 138K-subscriber candidate; no first-party channel ownership link established. No video attribution; verified own-channel inventory remains zero.
